subject: Commercial recovery plan — recurring 5xx/latency incidents and proposed remediation
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@haloml.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production impact: sustained 5xx spike + latency — immediate remediation requested

Hi Lukas,

We ran into another sustained period of increased 5xx errors and tail latency yesterday (2027-06-22 15:40–17:05 UTC) that materially reduced our throughput during a live demo with one of our enterprise prospects. Our engineers collected traces and error dumps — I've attached a logs archive.

This is the third incident this quarter and it's hitting our SLAs. We need:
- a summary of root cause analysis and immediate mitigations;
- an explicit remediation and testing timeline;
- a clear commercial remedy (service credits or other compensation) and contract amendment so we can assure our customer.

We are on a tight timeline — can you confirm an exec-level call today and a credible credit calculation by EOD tomorrow? We also need a temporary routing/fallback so our critical dev/prod traffic isn't impacted while you investigate.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
VP Product Operations | HaloML
[sent from mobile]

[attachment: error_logs_20270623.zip (log archive, 24MB)]

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@haloml.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production impact: sustained 5xx spike + latency — immediate remediation requested

Samantha — thanks for the quick heads up and for sending the logs. We're seriously on this. Proposed immediate steps:

1) Triage & containment (hours) — Monica and our infra on-call will:
   - enable an emergency dedicated routing pool for your prod key to remove noisy tenant interference;
   - apply a temporary KV cache bypass/refresh where we see stale state;
   - increase monitoring and immediate alerting to your SRE channel.
2) RCA & fix (24–72 hours) — we'll reproduce the pattern, identify the root kernel/path causing spike in 2xx->5xx conversions, and validate fixes in our staged infra.
3) Longer-term mitigations (1–3 weeks) — code-level fix, canary rollout, and a posterior regression test suite we run with your test prompts.

Commercially, per your ask: our standard SLA credit formula is in the contract but to move fast, I will put a preliminary commercial offer on the table: a one-time service credit equivalent to the lesser of (a) 10% of June invoice or (b) prorated downtime-based credit computed as (incident duration / billing period hours) * invoice amount. We can refine after RCA.

Can we do a 30-minute sync today at 11:30 PT? Monica will join for technical context and Laura will cover commercial next steps. I'll hold a provisional slot on my calendar.

-Lukas
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0128

Hi Samantha — Laura here (Commercial Ops). Appreciate the detail — sorry you're seeing this repeat. Quick commercial proposal to parallelize with Lukas' technical plan:

- Immediate: formal service credit proposal for June as Lukas outlined (provisional number by EOD tomorrow).
- Near-term: if RCA shows systemic platform shortfall, we will offer a three-month targeted price concession on your hosted spend for affected workloads (applied as a dollar credit on billing) and priority support hours at no additional cost.
- Contract path: we'll draft a short amendment (change order) that documents the credit, monitoring commitments, and a 90-day remediation SLA with defined milestones. That will be routed to your contracts team for quick signature.

Action items for today:
1) Confirmsync 11:30 PT (Lukas to send invite).
2) Luka s/Monica to provide containment ETA and any temporary routing changes in the call.
3) Ben will prep an amendment draft and a preliminary credit calc template.

We'll treat this as priority.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

[internal note: escalate to Grace for executive visibility if customer pushes for >15% credit or term changes]

Thanks Laura and Lukas — 11:30 PT works. Two asks ahead of the call:
- a clear draft of the calculation you plan to use for the provisional credit (simple spreadsheet or line items) so we can share with finance on our side;
- a runbook for the temporary routing/fallback you propose; ops-team is standing by.

We want to avoid a protracted back-and-forth. If this is systemic we will expect a firm commercial remediation and a contract amendment that protects our renewal.

I'll join with our Head of SRE (Mark Jensen) and procurement.

Samantha

Samantha — thanks for the call yesterday and for walking through the impact with Mark. Attached is the first-pass amendment and a short spreadsheet that implements the provisional credit calc we discussed:

- Base provisional credit = min(10% of June invoice, prorated-duration credit)
- Prorated-duration credit = (effective outage minutes / total billing minutes in June) * June invoice
- If RCA concludes platform fault, Redwood will apply the three-month price concession described on page 2 of the amendment.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached amendment draft and the credit spreadsheet and send redlines by Tue, 2027-06-29.
2) If you need faster execution, we'll accept a signed letter agreement confirming the provisional credit and remediation milestones; DocuSign link below.
3) Monica will deliver the runbook_autofailover_v2.docx into your SRE channel and post the containment play in our shared drive.

Links / attachments:
- Proposed amendment: proposed_amendment_draft_v1.pdf (attached)
- Provisional credit calc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-example
- DocuSign (provisional signature path): https://www.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-1234

Thanks — we'll prioritize this until it's resolved.
